original_test_intent: Retrieve and decode exactly one intended receive-queue message from the selected BMC over OOB IPMI, distinguish a defined empty-queue outcome, and demonstrate that no unrelated queued traffic or persistent diagnostics were consumed.
original_method: The Master is TBD. Standard Get Message 0x06/0x33 is an executable candidate only after an approved test message is correlated with the queue and its owner authorizes one destructive dequeue; the operation must not be treated as a harmless read loop.
manual_activity: Engineer coordinates the queue consumer, approves a single retrieval or defined empty check, provides the expected channel/protocol message and decides handling of any unexpected privileged payload.
required_inputs: Approved correlation-tagged test message or empty-queue scenario
Applicable Get Message response schema and protocol parser
Explicit authorization to consume at most one entry
safety_requirements: Do not clear SEL, logs or message flags
Do not inspect a shared production queue without owner coordination
Capture flags and queue context before retrieval
Execute at most one Get Message request per approval
Treat completion 0x80 as the defined no-data state rather than automatic retry
Never loop or drain remaining entries
Do not automatically reply to an obtained message
Preserve raw payload securely and redact only copies
agent_execution_scope: Resolve queue owner, channel and expected protocol
Capture pre-retrieval flags and management context
Show the one-request consumption scope for approval
Validate completion, returned channel/privilege and variable payload
Correlate the expected message and record exactly what was consumed
Perform read-only post-context checks without another dequeue
engineer_actions: Authorize consumption and coordinate other queue readers
Handle unexpected privileged or operational content

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: No command is provided because the source is TBD. Standard Get Message is recognizable, but execution would be unsafe and uninformative without an owned queue and expected message.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: After a documented stimulus and explicit one-entry approval, issue one `ipmitool ... raw 0x06 0x33`, decode the returned metadata/payload or approved no-data completion, and stop without polling.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Master TBD procedure/criteria and 10/5 timing remain unchanged; message count is bounded to one only as a safety gate, not asserted as a Master default.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a transaction harness that plants or coordinates one correlation-tagged message, snapshots pre-state, performs a single dequeue, validates protocol checksum/length and stores a cryptographically identified redacted evidence copy.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds a deterministic one-message oracle and queue-consumption controls to an empty source contract.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: An empty response tests empty-queue handling only; it does not prove retrieval and decode of an actual message. A Send Message success likewise does not prove this receive queue delivered it.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Concurrent consumers can win the race or cause the retrieved entry to differ from the stimulus. A Get operation permanently advances queue state and the original message cannot be restored by writing it back.

project_override_considerations: A vendor queue API is equivalent only when it uses the same receive queue and exposes consumption semantics, channel/privilege and raw payload. Non-destructive peek behavior is different coverage and must be labeled.
expected_evidence: BMC/queue/channel identity, owner coordination and approval
Pre-state flags/queue context and test-message correlation data
Single raw 0x06/0x33 request/response and completion handling
Returned channel, privilege and payload length/protocol/checksum decode
Secure raw evidence plus redacted report
Audit proving no second entry, flags, SEL or configuration was consumed or changed
Owner disposition of empty, unexpected or sensitive content

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: No source procedure or criteria exists to conflict with the title. Queue-consumption semantics and Expected are missing project details.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The command and risk are clear. Execution remains pending queue ownership, deterministic message scope, parser and approval rather than permanently blocked.

review_improvement: Recognizes Get Message as a destructive queue read, binds it to one expected entry or explicit empty scenario, and adds completion, privilege, payload-integrity and sensitive-data handling that the TBD source omits.
independent_technical_reasoning: A receive queue is stateful shared evidence. Repeated Get requests change the object being tested and can steal operational traffic, so a successful decode is not enough. The case must prove which message was expected, that exactly one request consumed it, and that concurrent consumers or an empty queue did not silently turn the result into false coverage.
